items.t: Duolingo CEO explains why ChatGPT and live translation won't replace the app
items.sum: Luis von Ahn, Duolingo Co-Founder & CEO, joins Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman to discuss accelerating daily active user growth, slashing AI video call costs to under a penny by shifting to open-weight models, and why chatbots won't replace language learning apps.

items.t: Duolingo CEO on owl's guilt-trip reminders: 'Passive-aggressive works'
items.sum: Duolingo's owl is still a winning strategy, keeping users motivated and using the app daily.

items.t: Open-weight AI models cut some Duolingo costs to 'less than a cent,' says CEO
items.sum: Duolingo (DUOL) co-founder and CEO Luis von Ahn joins Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to explain how moving its video-call language practice from frontier AI models to open-weight models reduced the cost 30-fold.

items.t: Could chatbots or AirPods replace Duolingo? CEO Luis von Ahn isn't worried.
items.sum: Duolingo (DUOL) co-founder and CEO Luis von Ahn joins Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss whether AI chatbots or AirPods with real-time translation could replace the language learning app and what edge it holds over those tools.

items.t: New EU rules could fix most annoying things about Ticketmaster, Duolingo and other apps
items.sum: ‘Digital Fairness Act’ aims to ban problems including addictive designs, tricks to play on people’s vulnerabilities and not being able to cancel subscriptions

items.t: Jefferies Maintains Hold on Duolingo, Raises Price Target to $175
items.sum: Jefferies analyst John Colantuoni maintains Duolingo (NASDAQ:DUOL) with a Hold and raises the price target from $145 to $175.
